<h1 id="dev_page_title">Bot API changelog</h1>
<div id="dev_page_content"><!-- scroll_nav -->

<blockquote>
<p>The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.<br>To learn how to create and set up a bot, please consult our <a href="https://core.telegram.org/bots"><strong>Introduction to Bots »</strong></a></p>
</blockquote>
<p>You will find all changes to our <a href="/bots/api"><strong>Bot API</strong></a> on this page.</p>
<h3><a class="anchor" name="recent-changes" href="#recent-changes"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>Recent changes</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>Subscribe to <a href="https://t.me/botnews">@BotNews</a> to be the first to know about the latest updates and join the discussion in <a href="https://t.me/bottalk">@BotTalk</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h3><a class="anchor" name="2026" href="#2026"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>2026</h3>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="august-24-2026" href="#august-24-2026"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>August 24, 2026</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 10.3</strong></p>
<p><strong>Rich Messages</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#richmessagebutton">RichMessageButton</a> representing a button in a <a href="/bots/api#richmessage">RichMessage</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#richtextbutton">RichTextButton</a>.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#richblockbuttons">RichBlockButtons</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockbuttons">InputRichBlockButtons</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>is_compact</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#richblocktable">RichBlockTable</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblocktable">InputRichBlockTable</a>.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#richblockexpandableblockquotation">RichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockexpandableblockquotation">InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation</a> representing a block quotation, which can be expanded or collapsed back.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#richblockdocument">RichBlockDocument</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockdocument">InputRichBlockDocument</a>, containing a file.</li>
<li>Added support for links of the form <code>tg://document?id=</code> for general file uploads in rich messages.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Ephemeral messages</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#ephemeralmessageparameters">EphemeralMessageParameters</a> and replaced the parameters <em>receiver_user_id</em> and <em>callback_query_id</em> in the methods <a href="/bots/api#sendmessage">sendMessage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendanimation">sendAnimation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendaudio">sendAudio</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddocument">sendDocument</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendlivephoto">sendLivePhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendphoto">sendPhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendsticker">sendSticker</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideo">sendVideo</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideonote">sendVideoNote</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvoice">sendVoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendcontact">sendContact</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendlocation">sendLocation</a> and <a href="/bots/api#sendvenue">sendVenue</a> with the parameter <em>ephemeral_message_parameters</em>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>ephemeral_message_parameters</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendrichmessage">sendRichMessage</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>replace_callback_query_message</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#ephemeralmessageparameters">EphemeralMessageParameters</a>, which allows bots to show an ephemeral message in place of the original message.</li>
<li>Supported upload of new files in <a href="/bots/api#editephemeralmessagemedia">editEphemeralMessageMedia</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>show_caption_above_media</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#editephemeralmessagecaption">editEphemeralMessageCaption</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>rich_message</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#editephemeralmessagetext">editEphemeralMessageText</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>can_send_welcome_messages</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#chatadministratorrights">ChatAdministratorRights</a> and <a href="/bots/api#chatmemberadministrator">ChatMemberAdministrator</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>can_send_welcome_messages</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#promotechatmember">promoteChatMember</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Reply markup</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#disabledbutton">DisabledButton</a> and the field <em>disabled</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#inlinekeyboardbutton">InlineKeyboardButton</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>force_reply</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#inlinekeyboardmarkup">InlineKeyboardMarkup</a> and <a href="/bots/api#replykeyboardmarkup">ReplyKeyboardMarkup</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>General</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the parameters <em>can_stop</em> and <em>keep_on_stop</em> to the methods <a href="/bots/api#sendmessagedraft">sendMessageDraft</a> and <a href="/bots/api#sendrichmessagedraft">sendRichMessageDraft</a>.</li>
<li>Added updates about user stopping message generation, represented by the class <a href="/bots/api#messagegenerationstopped">MessageGenerationStopped</a> and the field <em>stopped_message_generation</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#update">Update</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#communitychatjoined">CommunityChatJoined</a> and the field <em>community_chat_joined</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a> for service messages about join of a chat from a community.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>text</em>, <em>entities</em> and <em>is_private</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftinfo">UniqueGiftInfo</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="july-14-2026" href="#july-14-2026"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>July 14, 2026</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 10.2</strong></p>
<p><strong>Rich Messages</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputrichmessagemedia">InputRichMessageMedia</a> and the field <em>media</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#inputrichmessage">InputRichMessage</a>, allowing bots to explicitly specify media used in <em>markdown</em> or <em>html</em> formatting when sending a rich message.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputmediavoicenote">InputMediaVoiceNote</a>, representing a voice message to be sent.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblocklistitem">InputRichBlockListItem</a>, which represents an item in a list to be sent.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockparagraph">InputRichBlockParagraph</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblocksectionheading">InputRichBlockSectionHeading</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockpreformatted">InputRichBlockPreformatted</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockfooter">InputRichBlockFooter</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockdivider">InputRichBlockDivider</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockmathematicalexpression">InputRichBlockMathematicalExpression</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockanchor">InputRichBlockAnchor</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblocklist">InputRichBlockList</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockblockquotation">InputRichBlockBlockQuotation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockpullquotation">InputRichBlockPullQuotation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockcollage">InputRichBlockCollage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockslideshow">InputRichBlockSlideshow</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblocktable">InputRichBlockTable</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockdetails">InputRichBlockDetails</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockmap">InputRichBlockMap</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockanimation">InputRichBlockAnimation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockaudio">InputRichBlockAudio</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockphoto">InputRichBlockPhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockvideo">InputRichBlockVideo</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockvoicenote">InputRichBlockVoiceNote</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inputrichblockthinking">InputRichBlockThinking</a>, which represent different types of blocks available to format an outgoing rich message.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>blocks</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#inputrichmessage">InputRichMessage</a>, allowing bots to specify rich message formatting via block entities.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Ephemeral Messages</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Introduced support for <a href="/bots/features#ephemeral-messages">Ephemeral Messages</a>, allowing bots to send group messages and receive commands that are visible only to a specific user and the bot.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>is_ephemeral</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#botcommand">BotCommand</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>receiver_user</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>ephemeral_message_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameters <em>receiver_user_id</em> and <em>callback_query_id</em> to the methods <a href="/bots/api#sendmessage">sendMessage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendanimation">sendAnimation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendaudio">sendAudio</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddocument">sendDocument</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendlivephoto">sendLivePhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendphoto">sendPhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendsticker">sendSticker</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideo">sendVideo</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideonote">sendVideoNote</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvoice">sendVoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendcontact">sendContact</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendlocation">sendLocation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvenue">sendVenue</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>ephemeral_message_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#replyparameters">ReplyParameters</a>, allowing bots to reply to ephemeral messages.</li>
<li>Marked the field <em>message_id</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#replyparameters">ReplyParameters</a> as optional if the field <em>ephemeral_message_id</em> is present.</li>
<li>Added the methods <a href="/bots/api#editephemeralmessagetext">editEphemeralMessageText</a>, <a href="/bots/api#editephemeralmessagemedia">editEphemeralMessageMedia</a>, <a href="/bots/api#editephemeralmessagecaption">editEphemeralMessageCaption</a>, and <a href="/bots/api#editephemeralmessagereplymarkup">editEphemeralMessageReplyMarkup</a> allowing bots to edit ephemeral messages.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#deleteephemeralmessage">deleteEphemeralMessage</a> allowing bots to delete ephemeral messages.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Communities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Introduced initial support for <strong>Communities</strong> - several supergroups, channels, and bots linked together around a shared topic or audience.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#community">Community</a> which represents a community.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#communitychatadded">CommunityChatAdded</a> and the field <em>community_chat_added</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#communitychatremoved">CommunityChatRemoved</a> and the field <em>community_chat_removed</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>community</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>General</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added updates about changes to a user payment subscription, represented by the class <a href="/bots/api#botsubscriptionupdated">BotSubscriptionUpdated</a> and the field <em>subscription</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#update">Update</a>.</li>
<li>Hardened the security of Mini Apps by disallowing the usage of Mini App methods from origins different from the original Mini App domain. The protection will be automatically enabled for all Mini Apps on July 20, 2026. You can opt-out from the protection through the <a href="https://t.me/BotFather">@BotFather</a> Mini App. If you do so, you acknowledge that it is the responsibility of the bot to ensure that the Mini App has no links to untrusted sites.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="june-11-2026" href="#june-11-2026"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>June 11, 2026</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 10.1</strong></p>
<p><strong>Rich Messages</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added support for <a href="/bots/features#rich-messages">Rich Messages</a>, allowing bots to send highly structured text and stream AI-generated replies with seamless rich formatting.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#richtextbold">RichTextBold</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextitalic">RichTextItalic</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextunderline">RichTextUnderline</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextstrikethrough">RichTextStrikethrough</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextspoiler">RichTextSpoiler</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextdatetime">RichTextDateTime</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtexttextmention">RichTextTextMention</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextsubscript">RichTextSubscript</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextsuperscript">RichTextSuperscript</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextmarked">RichTextMarked</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextcode">RichTextCode</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextcustomemoji">RichTextCustomEmoji</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextmathematicalexpression">RichTextMathematicalExpression</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtexturl">RichTextUrl</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextemailaddress">RichTextEmailAddress</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextphonenumber">RichTextPhoneNumber</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextbankcardnumber">RichTextBankCardNumber</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextmention">RichTextMention</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtexthashtag">RichTextHashtag</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextcashtag">RichTextCashtag</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextbotcommand">RichTextBotCommand</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextanchor">RichTextAnchor</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextanchorlink">RichTextAnchorLink</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richtextreference">RichTextReference</a> and <a href="/bots/api#richtextreferencelink">RichTextReferenceLink</a>, which represent different types of rich formatted text.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#richtext">RichText</a>, which represents rich formatted text.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#richblockcaption">RichBlockCaption</a>, which represents the caption of a rich formatted text.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#richblocktablecell">RichBlockTableCell</a>, which represents a cell in a table.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#richblocklistitem">RichBlockListItem</a>, which represents an item in a list.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#richblockparagraph">RichBlockParagraph</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblocksectionheading">RichBlockSectionHeading</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockpreformatted">RichBlockPreformatted</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockfooter">RichBlockFooter</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockdivider">RichBlockDivider</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockmathematicalexpression">RichBlockMathematicalExpression</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockanchor">RichBlockAnchor</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblocklist">RichBlockList</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockblockquotation">RichBlockBlockQuotation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockpullquotation">RichBlockPullQuotation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockcollage">RichBlockCollage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockslideshow">RichBlockSlideshow</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblocktable">RichBlockTable</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockdetails">RichBlockDetails</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockmap">RichBlockMap</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockanimation">RichBlockAnimation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockaudio">RichBlockAudio</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockphoto">RichBlockPhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockvideo">RichBlockVideo</a>, <a href="/bots/api#richblockvoicenote">RichBlockVoiceNote</a> and <a href="/bots/api#richblockthinking">RichBlockThinking</a>, which represent different types of blocks in a rich formatted message.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#richblock">RichBlock</a>, which represents a block in a rich formatted message.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#richmessage">RichMessage</a>, which represents a rich formatted message.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>rich_message</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputrichmessage">InputRichMessage</a>, describing a rich message to send.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputrichmessagecontent">InputRichMessageContent</a> and allowed it to be used as <a href="/bots/api#inputmessagecontent">InputMessageContent</a> in results of inline, guest, and Web App queries.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#sendrichmessage">sendRichMessage</a>, allowing bots to send rich messages.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#sendrichmessagedraft">sendRichMessageDraft</a>, allowing bots to stream partial rich messages.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>rich_message</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#editmessagetext">editMessageText</a>, allowing bots to edit rich messages.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Join Request Queries</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>supports_join_request_queries</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#user">User</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>guard_bot</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>query_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatjoinrequest">ChatJoinRequest</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#answerchatjoinrequestquery">answerChatJoinRequestQuery</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#sendchatjoinrequestwebapp">sendChatJoinRequestWebApp</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Polls</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#link">Link</a> and the field <em>link</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#pollmedia">PollMedia</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputmedialink">InputMediaLink</a> and allowed it to be used as <a href="/bots/api#inputpolloptionmedia">InputPollOptionMedia</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="may-8-2026" href="#may-8-2026"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>May 8, 2026</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 10.0</strong></p>
<p><strong>Guest Mode</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Introduced support for <a href="/bots/features#guest-bots">guest mode</a>, allowing bots to receive certain messages and issue replies within chats they are not a member of.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>supports_guest_queries</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#user">User</a>.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>guest_bot_caller_user</em> and <em>guest_bot_caller_chat</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>guest_query_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>guest_message</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#update">Update</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#sentguestmessage">SentGuestMessage</a> and the method <a href="/bots/api#answerguestquery">answerGuestQuery</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Chat Management</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>can_react_to_messages</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#chatmemberrestricted">ChatMemberRestricted</a> and <a href="/bots/api#chatpermissions">ChatPermissions</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>return_bots</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#getchatadministrators">getChatAdministrators</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#deleteallmessagereactions">deleteAllMessageReactions</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#deletemessagereaction">deleteMessageReaction</a>.</li>
<li>Added the ability to see certain messages sent by other bots in groups.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Polls</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#inputmediasticker">InputMediaSticker</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputmedialocation">InputMediaLocation</a>, and <a href="/bots/api#inputmediavenue">InputMediaVenue</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#pollmedia">PollMedia</a>, representing a media in a poll.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>media</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#poll">Poll</a>, allowing bots to see media in polls.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>explanation_media</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#poll">Poll</a>, allowing bots to see media in quiz explanations.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>media</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#polloption">PollOption</a>, allowing bots to see media in poll options.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputpollmedia">InputPollMedia</a> and the parameters <em>media</em> and <em>explanation_media</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>, allowing bots to add media to polls.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputpolloptionmedia">InputPollOptionMedia</a> and the field <em>media</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#inputpolloption">InputPollOption</a>, allowing bots to add media to poll options.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>members_only</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#poll">Poll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>members_only</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>country_codes</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#poll">Poll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>country_codes</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>.</li>
<li>Decreased the minimum number of poll options from 2 to 1.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Live photos</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#livephoto">LivePhoto</a>, which represents a photo with a short video.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputmedialivephoto">InputMediaLivePhoto</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>live_photo</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a> and <a href="/bots/api#externalreplyinfo">ExternalReplyInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#sendlivephoto">sendLivePhoto</a>, allowing bots to send live photos.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#paidmedialivephoto">PaidMediaLivePhoto</a>, which describes a paid media with a live photo.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputpaidmedialivephoto">InputPaidMediaLivePhoto</a>, allowing bots to send live photos as paid media.</li>
<li>Allowed to use live photos in <a href="/bots/api#sendmediagroup">sendMediaGroup</a> and <a href="/bots/api#editmessagemedia">editMessageMedia</a>,</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>General</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Allowed Business Bots to manage user accounts without a Telegram Premium subscription.</li>
<li>Added the ability to send messages to other bots via username if both bots enabled bot-to-bot communication.</li>
<li>Added the ability to reply to other bots from a business bot if the business bot enabled bot-to-bot communication.</li>
<li>Allowed bots to pass an empty text in the method <a href="/bots/api#sendmessagedraft">sendMessageDraft</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#botaccesssettings">BotAccessSettings</a> and the method <a href="/bots/api#getmanagedbotaccesssettings">getManagedBotAccessSettings</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#setmanagedbotaccesssettings">setManagedBotAccessSettings</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#getuserpersonalchatmessages">getUserPersonalChatMessages</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="april-3-2026" href="#april-3-2026"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>April 3, 2026</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 9.6</strong></p>
<p><strong>Managed Bots</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>can_manage_bots</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#user">User</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#keyboardbuttonrequestmanagedbot">KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot</a> and the field <em>request_managed_bot</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#keyboardbutton">KeyboardButton</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#managedbotcreated">ManagedBotCreated</a> and the field <em>managed_bot_created</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added updates about the creation of managed bots and the change of their token, represented by the class <a href="/bots/api#managedbotupdated">ManagedBotUpdated</a> and the field <em>managed_bot</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#update">Update</a>.</li>
<li>Added the methods <a href="/bots/api#getmanagedbottoken">getManagedBotToken</a> and <a href="/bots/api#replacemanagedbottoken">replaceManagedBotToken</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#preparedkeyboardbutton">PreparedKeyboardButton</a> and the method <a href="/bots/api#savepreparedkeyboardbutton">savePreparedKeyboardButton</a>, allowing bots to request users, chats and managed bots from Mini Apps.</li>
<li>Added the method <em>requestChat</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>.</li>
<li>Added support for <code>https://t.me/newbot/{manager_bot_username}/{suggested_bot_username}[?name={suggested_bot_name}]</code> links, allowing bots to request the creation of a managed bot via a link.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Polls</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added support for quizzes with multiple correct answers.</li>
<li>Replaced the field <em>correct_option_id</em> with the field <em>correct_option_ids</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#poll">Poll</a>.</li>
<li>Replaced the parameter <em>correct_option_id</em> with the parameter <em>correct_option_ids</em> in the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>.</li>
<li>Allowed to pass <em>allows_multiple_answers</em> for quizzes in the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>.</li>
<li>Increased the maximum time for automatic poll closure to 2628000 seconds.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>allows_revoting</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#poll">Poll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>allows_revoting</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>shuffle_options</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>allow_adding_options</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>hide_results_until_closes</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>description</em> and <em>description_entities</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#poll">Poll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameters <em>description</em>, <em>description_parse_mode</em>, and <em>description_entities</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>persistent_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#polloption">PollOption</a>, representing a persistent identifier for the option.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>option_persistent_ids</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#pollanswer">PollAnswer</a>.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>added_by_user</em> and <em>added_by_chat</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#polloption">PollOption</a>, denoting the user and the chat which added the option.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>addition_date</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#polloption">PollOption</a>, describing the date when the option was added.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#polloptionadded">PollOptionAdded</a> and the field <em>poll_option_added</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#polloptiondeleted">PollOptionDeleted</a> and the field <em>poll_option_deleted</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>poll_option_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#replyparameters">ReplyParameters</a>, allowing bots to reply to a specific poll option.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>reply_to_poll_option_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Allowed “date_time” entities in <a href="/bots/api#inputchecklist">checklist</a> title, <a href="/bots/api#inputchecklisttask">checklist task</a> text, <a href="/bots/api#textquote">TextQuote</a>, <a href="/bots/api#replyparameters">ReplyParameters</a> quote, <a href="/bots/api#sendgift">sendGift</a>, and <a href="/bots/api#giftpremiumsubscription">giftPremiumSubscription</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="march-1-2026" href="#march-1-2026"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>March 1, 2026</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 9.5</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the <a href="/bots/api#messageentity">MessageEntity</a> type “date_time”, allowing bots to show a formatted date and time to the user.</li>
<li>Allowed all bots to use the method <a href="/bots/api#sendmessagedraft">sendMessageDraft</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>tag</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#chatmembermember">ChatMemberMember</a> and <a href="/bots/api#chatmemberrestricted">ChatMemberRestricted</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#setchatmembertag">setChatMemberTag</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>can_edit_tag</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#chatmemberrestricted">ChatMemberRestricted</a> and <a href="/bots/api#chatpermissions">ChatPermissions</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>can_manage_tags</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#chatmemberadministrator">ChatMemberAdministrator</a> and <a href="/bots/api#chatadministratorrights">ChatAdministratorRights</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>can_manage_tags</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#promotechatmember">promoteChatMember</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>sender_tag</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>iconCustomEmojiId</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#bottombutton">BottomButton</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="february-9-2026" href="#february-9-2026"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>February 9, 2026</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 9.4</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Allowed bots to use custom emoji in messages directly sent by the bot to private, group and supergroup chats if the owner of the bot has a Telegram Premium subscription.</li>
<li>Allowed bots to create topics in private chats using the method <a href="/bots/api#createforumtopic">createForumTopic</a>.</li>
<li>Allowed bots to prevent users from creating and deleting topics in private chats through a new setting in the <a href="https://t.me/BotFather">@BotFather</a> Mini App.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>allows_users_to_create_topics</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#user">User</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>icon_custom_emoji_id</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#keyboardbutton">KeyboardButton</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inlinekeyboardbutton">InlineKeyboardButton</a>, allowing bots to show a custom emoji on buttons if they are able to use custom emoji in the message.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>style</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#keyboardbutton">KeyboardButton</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inlinekeyboardbutton">InlineKeyboardButton</a>, allowing bots to change the color of buttons.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#chatownerleft">ChatOwnerLeft</a> and the field <em>chat_owner_left</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#chatownerchanged">ChatOwnerChanged</a> and the field <em>chat_owner_changed</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the methods <a href="/bots/api#setmyprofilephoto">setMyProfilePhoto</a> and <a href="/bots/api#removemyprofilephoto">removeMyProfilePhoto</a>, allowing bots to manage their profile picture.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#videoquality">VideoQuality</a> and the field <em>qualities</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#video">Video</a> allowing bots to get information about other available qualities of a video.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>first_profile_audio</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#userprofileaudios">UserProfileAudios</a> and the method <a href="/bots/api#getuserprofileaudios">getUserProfileAudios</a>, allowing bots to fetch a list of audios added to the profile of a user.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>rarity</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftmodel">UniqueGiftModel</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>is_burned</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegift">UniqueGift</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h3><a class="anchor" name="2025" href="#2025"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>2025</h3>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="december-31-2025" href="#december-31-2025"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>December 31, 2025</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 9.3</strong></p>
<p><strong>Topics in private chats</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>has_topics_enabled</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#user">User</a>, which can be used to determine whether forum topic mode is enabled for the bot in private chats.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#sendmessagedraft">sendMessageDraft</a>, allowing partial messages to be streamed to a user while being generated.</li>
<li>Supported the fields <em>message_thread_id</em> and <em>is_topic_message</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a> for messages in private chats with forum topic mode enabled.</li>
<li>Supported the parameter <em>message_thread_id</em> in private chats with topics in the methods <a href="/bots/api#sendmessage">sendMessage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendphoto">sendPhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideo">sendVideo</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendanimation">sendAnimation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendaudio">sendAudio</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddocument">sendDocument</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendpaidmedia">sendPaidMedia</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendsticker">sendSticker</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideonote">sendVideoNote</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvoice">sendVoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendlocation">sendLocation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvenue">sendVenue</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendcontact">sendContact</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddice">sendDice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendinvoice">sendInvoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendgame">sendGame</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendmediagroup">sendMediaGroup</a>, <a href="/bots/api#copymessage">copyMessage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#copymessages">copyMessages</a>, <a href="/bots/api#forwardmessage">forwardMessage</a>, and <a href="/bots/api#forwardmessages">forwardMessages</a>, allowing bots to send a message to a specific topic.</li>
<li>Supported the parameter <em>message_thread_id</em> in private chats in the method <a href="/bots/api#sendchataction">sendChatAction</a>, allowing bots to send chat actions to a specific topic in private chats.</li>
<li>Supported the parameter <em>message_thread_id</em> in private chats with topics in the method <a href="/bots/api#editforumtopic">editForumTopic</a>, <a href="/bots/api#deleteforumtopic">deleteForumTopic</a>, and <a href="/bots/api#unpinallforumtopicmessages">unpinAllForumTopicMessages</a>, allowing bots to manage topics in private chats.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>is_name_implicit</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#forumtopic">ForumTopic</a> and <a href="/bots/api#forumtopiccreated">ForumTopicCreated</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Gifts</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the methods <a href="/bots/api#getusergifts">getUserGifts</a> and <a href="/bots/api#getchatgifts">getChatGifts</a>.</li>
<li>Replaced the field <em>last_resale_star_count</em> with the fields <em>last_resale_currency</em> and <em>last_resale_amount</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftinfo">UniqueGiftInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Replaced the parameter <em>exclude_limited</em> with the parameters <em>exclude_limited_upgradable</em> and <em>exclude_limited_non_upgradable</em> in the method <a href="/bots/api#getbusinessaccountgifts">getBusinessAccountGifts</a>.</li>
<li>Added the value “gifted_upgrade” as a possible value of <em>UniqueGiftInfo.origin</em> for messages about the upgrade of a gift that was purchased after it was sent.</li>
<li>Added the value “offer” as a possible value of <em>UniqueGiftInfo.origin</em> for messages about the purchase of a gift through a purchase offer.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>gift_upgrade_sent</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>gift_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegift">UniqueGift</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>is_from_blockchain</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegift">UniqueGift</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>exclude_from_blockchain</em> in the method <a href="/bots/api#getbusinessaccountgifts">getBusinessAccountGifts</a>, to filter out gifts that were assigned from the TON blockchain.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>personal_total_count</em> and <em>personal_remaining_count</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#gift">Gift</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>is_premium</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#gift">Gift</a> and <a href="/bots/api#uniquegift">UniqueGift</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>is_upgrade_separate</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#giftinfo">GiftInfo</a> and <a href="/bots/api#ownedgiftregular">OwnedGiftRegular</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftcolors">UniqueGiftColors</a> that describes the color scheme for a user&#39;s name, replies to messages and link previews based on a unique gift.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>has_colors</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#gift">Gift</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>colors</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegift">UniqueGift</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#giftbackground">GiftBackground</a> and the field <em>background</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#gift">Gift</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>unique_gift_variant_count</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#gift">Gift</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>unique_gift_number</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#giftinfo">GiftInfo</a> and <a href="/bots/api#ownedgiftregular">OwnedGiftRegular</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>gifts_from_channels</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#acceptedgifttypes">AcceptedGiftTypes</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Miscellaneous</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Allowed bots to disable their main username if they have additional active usernames purchased on Fragment.</li>
<li>Allowed bots to disable the right <em>can_restrict_members</em> in channel chats.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#repoststory">repostStory</a>, allowing bots to repost stories across different business accounts they manage.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#userrating">UserRating</a> and the field <em>rating</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Increased the maximum price for paid media to 25000 Telegram Stars.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>paid_message_star_count</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>message_effect_id</em> to the methods <a href="/bots/api#forwardmessage">forwardMessage</a> and <a href="/bots/api#copymessage">copyMessage</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>unique_gift_colors</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>completed_by_chat</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#checklisttask">ChecklistTask</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="august-15-2025" href="#august-15-2025"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>August 15, 2025</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 9.2</strong></p>
<p><strong>Checklists</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>checklist_task_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#replyparameters">ReplyParameters</a>, allowing bots to reply to a specific checklist task.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>reply_to_checklist_task_id</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Gifts</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>publisher_chat</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#gift">Gift</a> and <a href="/bots/api#uniquegift">UniqueGift</a> which can be used to get information about the chat that published a gift.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Direct Messages in Channels</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>is_direct_messages</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#chat">Chat</a> and <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a> which can be used to identify supergroups that are used as channel direct messages chats.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>parent_chat</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a> which indicates the parent channel chat for a channel direct messages chat.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#directmessagestopic">DirectMessagesTopic</a> and the field <em>direct_messages_topic</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a topic of a direct messages chat.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>direct_messages_topic_id</em> to the methods <a href="/bots/api#sendmessage">sendMessage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendphoto">sendPhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideo">sendVideo</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendanimation">sendAnimation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendaudio">sendAudio</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddocument">sendDocument</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendpaidmedia">sendPaidMedia</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendsticker">sendSticker</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideonote">sendVideoNote</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvoice">sendVoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendlocation">sendLocation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvenue">sendVenue</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendcontact">sendContact</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddice">sendDice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendinvoice">sendInvoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendmediagroup">sendMediaGroup</a>, <a href="/bots/api#copymessage">copyMessage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#copymessages">copyMessages</a>, <a href="/bots/api#forwardmessage">forwardMessage</a> and <a href="/bots/api#forwardmessages">forwardMessages</a>. This parameter can be used to send a message to a direct messages chat topic.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Suggested Posts</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#suggestedpostparameters">SuggestedPostParameters</a> and the parameter <em>suggested_post_parameters</em> to the methods <a href="/bots/api#sendmessage">sendMessage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendphoto">sendPhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideo">sendVideo</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendanimation">sendAnimation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendaudio">sendAudio</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddocument">sendDocument</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendpaidmedia">sendPaidMedia</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendsticker">sendSticker</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideonote">sendVideoNote</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvoice">sendVoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendlocation">sendLocation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvenue">sendVenue</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendcontact">sendContact</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddice">sendDice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendinvoice">sendInvoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#copymessage">copyMessage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#forwardmessage">forwardMessage</a>. This parameter can be used to send a suggested post to a direct messages chat topic.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#approvesuggestedpost">approveSuggestedPost</a>, allowing bots to approve incoming suggested posts.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#declinesuggestedpost">declineSuggestedPost</a>, allowing bots to decline incoming suggested posts.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>can_manage_direct_messages</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#chatmemberadministrator">ChatMemberAdministrator</a> and <a href="/bots/api#chatadministratorrights">ChatAdministratorRights</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>can_manage_direct_messages</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#promotechatmember">promoteChatMember</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>is_paid_post</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, which can be used to identify paid posts. Such posts must not be deleted for 24 hours to receive the payment.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#suggestedpostprice">SuggestedPostPrice</a>, describing the price of a suggested post.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#suggestedpostinfo">SuggestedPostInfo</a> and the field <em>suggested_post_info</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a suggested post.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#suggestedpostapproved">SuggestedPostApproved</a> and the field <em>suggested_post_approved</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about the approval of a suggested post.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#suggestedpostapprovalfailed">SuggestedPostApprovalFailed</a> and the field <em>suggested_post_approval_failed</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about the failed approval of a suggested post.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#suggestedpostdeclined">SuggestedPostDeclined</a> and the field <em>suggested_post_declined</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about the rejection of a suggested post.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#suggestedpostpaid">SuggestedPostPaid</a> and the field <em>suggested_post_paid</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about a successful payment for a suggested post.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#suggestedpostrefunded">SuggestedPostRefunded</a> and the field <em>suggested_post_refunded</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about a payment refund for a suggested post.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="july-3-2025" href="#july-3-2025"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>July 3, 2025</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 9.1</strong></p>
<p><strong>Checklists</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#checklisttask">ChecklistTask</a> representing a task in a checklist.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#checklist">Checklist</a> representing a checklist.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputchecklisttask">InputChecklistTask</a> representing a task to add to a checklist.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputchecklist">InputChecklist</a> representing a checklist to create.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>checklist</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a> and <a href="/bots/api#externalreplyinfo">ExternalReplyInfo</a>, describing a checklist in a message.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#checklisttasksdone">ChecklistTasksDone</a> and the field <em>checklist_tasks_done</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about status changes for tasks in a checklist (i.e., marked as done/not done).</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#checklisttasksadded">ChecklistTasksAdded</a> and the field <em>checklist_tasks_added</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about the addition of new tasks to a checklist.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#sendchecklist">sendChecklist</a>, allowing bots to send a checklist on behalf of a business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#editmessagechecklist">editMessageChecklist</a>, allowing bots to edit a checklist on behalf of a business account.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Gifts</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>next_transfer_date</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#ownedgiftunique">OwnedGiftUnique</a> and <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftinfo">UniqueGiftInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>last_resale_star_count</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftinfo">UniqueGiftInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added “resale” as the possible value of the field <em>origin</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftinfo">UniqueGiftInfo</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>General</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Increased the maximum number of options in a poll to 12.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#getmystarbalance">getMyStarBalance</a>, allowing bots to get their current balance of Telegram Stars.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#directmessagepricechanged">DirectMessagePriceChanged</a> and the field <em>direct_message_price_changed</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about a price change for direct messages sent to the channel chat.</li>
<li>Added the method <em>hideKeyboard</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="april-11-2025" href="#april-11-2025"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>April 11, 2025</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 9.0</strong></p>
<p><strong>Business Accounts</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#businessbotrights">BusinessBotRights</a> and replaced the field <em>can_reply</em> with the field <em>rights</em> of the type <a href="/bots/api#businessbotrights">BusinessBotRights</a> in the class <a href="/bots/api#businessconnection">BusinessConnection</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#readbusinessmessage">readBusinessMessage</a>, allowing bots to mark incoming messages as read on behalf of a business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#deletebusinessmessages">deleteBusinessMessages</a>, allowing bots to delete messages on behalf of a business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#setbusinessaccountname">setBusinessAccountName</a>, allowing bots to change the first and last name of a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#setbusinessaccountusername">setBusinessAccountUsername</a>, allowing bots to change the username of a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#setbusinessaccountbio">setBusinessAccountBio</a>, allowing bots to change the bio of a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#inputprofilephoto">InputProfilePhoto</a>, describing a profile photo to be set.</li>
<li>Added the methods <a href="/bots/api#setbusinessaccountprofilephoto">setBusinessAccountProfilePhoto</a> and <a href="/bots/api#removebusinessaccountprofilephoto">removeBusinessAccountProfilePhoto</a>, allowing bots to change the profile photo of a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#setbusinessaccountgiftsettings">setBusinessAccountGiftSettings</a>, allowing bots to change the privacy settings pertaining to incoming gifts in a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#staramount">StarAmount</a> and the method <a href="/bots/api#getbusinessaccountstarbalance">getBusinessAccountStarBalance</a>, allowing bots to check the current Telegram Star balance of a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#transferbusinessaccountstars">transferBusinessAccountStars</a>, allowing bots to transfer Telegram Stars from the balance of a managed business account to their own balance for withdrawal.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#ownedgiftregular">OwnedGiftRegular</a>, <a href="/bots/api#ownedgiftunique">OwnedGiftUnique</a>, <a href="/bots/api#ownedgifts">OwnedGifts</a> and the method <a href="/bots/api#getbusinessaccountgifts">getBusinessAccountGifts</a>, allowing bots to fetch the list of gifts owned by a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#convertgifttostars">convertGiftToStars</a>, allowing bots to convert gifts received by a managed business account to Telegram Stars.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#upgradegift">upgradeGift</a>, allowing bots to upgrade regular gifts received by a managed business account to unique gifts.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#transfergift">transferGift</a>, allowing bots to transfer unique gifts owned by a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#inputstorycontentphoto">InputStoryContentPhoto</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inputstorycontentvideo">InputStoryContentVideo</a> representing the content of a story to post.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#storyarea">StoryArea</a>, <a href="/bots/api#storyareaposition">StoryAreaPosition</a>, <a href="/bots/api#locationaddress">LocationAddress</a>, <a href="/bots/api#storyareatypelocation">StoryAreaTypeLocation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#storyareatypesuggestedreaction">StoryAreaTypeSuggestedReaction</a>, <a href="/bots/api#storyareatypelink">StoryAreaTypeLink</a>, <a href="/bots/api#storyareatypeweather">StoryAreaTypeWeather</a> and <a href="/bots/api#storyareatypeuniquegift">StoryAreaTypeUniqueGift</a>, describing clickable active areas on stories.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#poststory">postStory</a>, allowing bots to post a story on behalf of a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#editstory">editStory</a>, allowing bots to edit stories they had previously posted on behalf of a managed business account.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#deletestory">deleteStory</a>, allowing bots to delete stories they had previously posted on behalf of a managed business account.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Mini Apps</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <a href="/bots/webapps#devicestorage">DeviceStorage</a>, allowing Mini Apps to use persistent local storage on the user&#39;s device.</li>
<li>Added the field <a href="/bots/webapps#securestorage">SecureStorage</a>, allowing Mini Apps to use a secure local storage on the user&#39;s device for sensitive data.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Gifts</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftmodel">UniqueGiftModel</a>, <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftsymbol">UniqueGiftSymbol</a>, <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftbackdropcolors">UniqueGiftBackdropColors</a>, and <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftbackdrop">UniqueGiftBackdrop</a> to describe the properties of a unique gift.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegift">UniqueGift</a> describing a gift that was upgraded to a unique one.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#acceptedgifttypes">AcceptedGiftTypes</a> describing the types of gifts that are accepted by a user or a chat.</li>
<li>Replaced the field <em>can_send_gift</em> with the field <em>accepted_gift_types</em> of the type <a href="/bots/api#acceptedgifttypes">AcceptedGiftTypes</a> in the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#giftinfo">GiftInfo</a> and the field <em>gift</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about a regular gift that was sent or received.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#uniquegiftinfo">UniqueGiftInfo</a> and the field <em>unique_gift</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about a unique gift that was sent or received.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Telegram Premium</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#giftpremiumsubscription">giftPremiumSubscription</a>, allowing bots to gift a user a Telegram Premium subscription paid in Telegram Stars.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>premium_subscription_duration</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartneruser">TransactionPartnerUser</a> for transactions involving a Telegram Premium subscription purchased by the bot.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>transaction_type</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartneruser">TransactionPartnerUser</a>, simplifying the differentiation and processing of all transaction types.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>General</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Increased the maximum price for paid media to 10000 Telegram Stars.</li>
<li>Increased the maximum price for a subscription period to 10000 Telegram Stars.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#paidmessagepricechanged">PaidMessagePriceChanged</a> and the field <em>paid_message_price_changed</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about a price change for paid messages sent to the chat.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>paid_star_count</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, containing the number of <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/telegram-stars">Telegram Stars</a> that were paid to send the message.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="february-12-2025" href="#february-12-2025"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>February 12, 2025</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 8.3</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the parameter <em>chat_id</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendgift">sendGift</a>, allowing bots to send gifts to channel chats.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>can_send_gift</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartnerchat">TransactionPartnerChat</a> describing transactions with chats.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>cover</em> and <em>start_timestamp</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#video">Video</a>, containing a message-specific cover and a start timestamp for the video.</li>
<li>Added the parameters <em>cover</em> and <em>start_timestamp</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendvideo">sendVideo</a>, allowing bots to specify a cover and a start timestamp for the videos they send.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>cover</em> and <em>start_timestamp</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#inputmediavideo">InputMediaVideo</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inputpaidmediavideo">InputPaidMediaVideo</a>, allowing bots to edit video cover and start timestamp and specify them for videos in albums and paid media.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>video_start_timestamp</em> to the methods <a href="/bots/api#forwardmessage">forwardMessage</a> and <a href="/bots/api#copymessage">copyMessage</a>, allowing bots to change the start timestamp for forwarded and copied videos.</li>
<li>Allowed to add reactions to most types of service messages.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="january-1-2025" href="#january-1-2025"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>January 1, 2025</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 8.2</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the methods <a href="/bots/api#verifyuser">verifyUser</a>, <a href="/bots/api#verifychat">verifyChat</a>, <a href="/bots/api#removeuserverification">removeUserVerification</a> and <a href="/bots/api#removechatverification">removeChatVerification</a>, allowing bots to manage <a href="https://telegram.org/verify#third-party-verification">verifications on behalf of an organization</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>upgrade_star_count</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#gift">Gift</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>pay_for_upgrade</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendgift">sendGift</a>.</li>
<li>Removed the field <em>hide_url</em> from the class <a href="/bots/api#inlinequeryresultarticle">InlineQueryResultArticle</a>. Pass an empty string as <em>url</em> instead.</li>
</ul>
<h3><a class="anchor" name="2024" href="#2024"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>2024</h3>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="december-4-2024" href="#december-4-2024"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>December 4, 2024</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 8.1</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>nanostar_amount</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#startransaction">StarTransaction</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartneraffiliateprogram">TransactionPartnerAffiliateProgram</a> for transactions pertaining to incoming affiliate commissions.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#affiliateinfo">AffiliateInfo</a> and the field <em>affiliate</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartneruser">TransactionPartnerUser</a>, allowing bots to identify the relevant affiliate in transactions with an affiliate commission.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="november-17-2024" href="#november-17-2024"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>November 17, 2024</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 8.0</strong></p>
<blockquote>
<p>Bot API 8.0 introduces <strong>10 powerful new features</strong> for Mini Apps - including the ability to enter <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more#full-screen-mode">full-screen mode</a>, launch from <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more#home-screen-shortcuts">home screen shortcuts</a>, offer <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more#subscription-plans">subscription plans</a> and more. Check out all the details in our dedicated <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more">blog</a> and Mini App <a href="/bots/webapps">documentation</a>.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>Star Subscriptions</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bots now support <strong>paid subscriptions</strong> powered by <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/telegram-stars">Telegram Stars</a> - <strong>monetizing their efforts</strong> with multiple tiers of content and features.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>subscription_period</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#createinvoicelink">createInvoiceLink</a> to support the creation of links that are billed periodically.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>business_connection_id</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#createinvoicelink">createInvoiceLink</a> to support the creation of invoice links on behalf of business accounts.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>subscription_expiration_date</em>, <em>is_recurring</em> and <em>is_first_recurring</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#successfulpayment">SuccessfulPayment</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#edituserstarsubscription">editUserStarSubscription</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>subscription_period</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartneruser">TransactionPartnerUser</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Full-screen Mode</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Mini Apps are now able to <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more#full-screen-mode">become full-screen</a> in both portrait and <strong>landscape mode</strong> - allowing them to host <strong>more games</strong>, play <strong>widescreen media</strong> and support <strong>immersive</strong> user experiences.</li>
<li>Added the methods <em>requestFullscreen</em> and <em>exitFullscreen</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a> to toggle full-screen mode.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>safeAreaInset</em> and <em>contentSafeAreaInset</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>, allowing Mini Apps to ensure that their content properly respects the device&#39;s safe area margins.</li>
<li>Further added the fields <em>isActive</em> and <em>isFullscreen</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>.</li>
<li>Added the <a href="/bots/webapps#events-available-for-mini-apps">events</a> <em>activated</em>, <em>deactivated</em>, <em>safeAreaChanged</em>, <em>contentSafeAreaChanged</em>, <em>fullscreenChanged</em> and <em>fullscreenFailed</em> for Mini Apps.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Homescreen Shortcuts</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Mini Apps can now be accessed via <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more#home-screen-shortcuts">direct shortcuts</a> added to the <strong>home screen</strong> of mobile devices.</li>
<li>Added the method <em>addToHomeScreen</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a> to create a shortcut for users to add to their home screens.</li>
<li>Added the method <em>checkHomeScreenStatus</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a> to determine the status and support of the home screen shortcut for the Mini App on the current device.</li>
<li>Added the <a href="/bots/webapps#events-available-for-mini-apps">events</a> <em>homeScreenAdded</em> and <em>homeScreenChecked</em> for Mini Apps.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Emoji Status</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Mini Apps can now prompt users to set their <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more#emoji-statuses-from-apps">emoji status</a> - or request access to later sync it automatically with in-game badges, third-party APIs and more.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#setuseremojistatus">setUserEmojiStatus</a>. The user must allow the bot to manage their emoji status.</li>
<li>Added the method <em>setEmojiStatus</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a> to let users manually confirm a custom emoji as their new status via a native dialog.</li>
<li>Added the method <em>requestEmojiStatusAccess</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a> for obtaining permission to later update a user&#39;s emoji status via the Bot API method <a href="/bots/api#setuseremojistatus">setUserEmojiStatus</a>.</li>
<li>Added the <a href="/bots/webapps#events-available-for-mini-apps">events</a> <em>emojiStatusSet</em>, <em>emojiStatusFailed</em> and <em>emojiStatusAccessRequested</em> for Mini Apps.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Media Sharing and File Downloads</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Users can now <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more#media-sharing">share media</a> directly from Mini Apps - sending <strong>referral codes</strong>, custom memes, artwork and more to <strong>any chat</strong> or posting them <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/w3-browser-mini-app-store#sharing-from-mini-apps-to-stories">as a story</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#preparedinlinemessage">PreparedInlineMessage</a> and the method <a href="/bots/api#savepreparedinlinemessage">savePreparedInlineMessage</a>, allowing bots to suggest users to send a specific message from a Mini App via the method <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">shareMessage</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <em>shareMessage</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a> to share media from Mini Apps to Telegram chats.</li>
<li>Added the method <em>downloadFile</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>, introducing support for a <strong>native popup</strong> that prompts users to download files from the Mini App.</li>
<li>Added the <a href="/bots/webapps#events-available-for-mini-apps">events</a> <em>shareMessageSent</em>, <em>shareMessageFailed</em> and <em>fileDownloadRequested</em> for Mini Apps.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Geolocation Access</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Mini Apps can now request <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more#geolocation-access">geolocation access</a> to users, allowing them to build virtually any location-based service, from <strong>games</strong> with dynamic points of interest to <strong>interactive maps</strong> for events.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>LocationManager</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>.</li>
<li>Added the <a href="/bots/webapps#events-available-for-mini-apps">events</a> <em>locationManagerUpdated</em> and <em>locationRequested</em> for Mini Apps.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Device Motion Tracking</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Mini Apps can now track detailed <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/fullscreen-miniapps-and-more#device-motion-tracking">device motion data</a>, allowing them to implement better productivity tools, immersive <strong>VR experiences</strong> and more.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>isOrientationLocked</em>, <em>Accelerometer</em>, <em>DeviceOrientation</em> and <em>Gyroscope</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>.</li>
<li>Added the methods <em>lockOrientation</em> and <em>unlockOrientation</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a> to control the screen orientation.</li>
<li>Added the <a href="/bots/webapps#events-available-for-mini-apps">events</a> <em>accelerometerStarted</em>, <em>accelerometerStopped</em>, <em>accelerometerChanged</em>, <em>accelerometerFailed</em>, <em>deviceOrientationStarted</em>, <em>deviceOrientationStopped</em>, <em>deviceOrientationChanged</em>, <em>deviceOrientationFailed</em>, <em>gyroscopeStarted</em>, <em>gyroscopeStopped</em>, <em>gyroscopeChanged</em>, <em>gyroscopeFailed</em> for Mini Apps.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Gifts</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bots can now send <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/gifts-verification-platform#gifts">Paid Gifts</a> to users in exchange for Telegram Stars.</li>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#gift">Gift</a> and <a href="/bots/api#gifts">Gifts</a> and the method <a href="/bots/api#getavailablegifts">getAvailableGifts</a>, allowing bots to get all gifts available for sending.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#sendgift">sendGift</a>, allowing bots to send gifts to users.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>gift</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartneruser">TransactionPartnerUser</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Loading Screen Customization</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Mini Apps can customize their loading screen, adding <strong>their own icon</strong> and <strong>specific colors</strong> for light and dark themes.</li>
<li>You can access these customization settings in <a href="https://t.me/botfather">@BotFather</a> via <em>/mybots &gt; Select Bot &gt; Bot Settings &gt; Configure Mini App &gt; Enable Mini App</em></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Hardware-specific Optimizations</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Mini Apps running on Android can now receive <a href="/bots/webapps#additional-data-in-user-agent">basic information</a> about a device&#39;s processing hardware, allowing them to <strong>optimize user experience</strong> based on the device&#39;s capabilities.</li>
<li>This information includes the OS, App and SDK&#39;s respective versions as well as the device&#39;s model and performance class.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong> General </strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the field <em>photo_url</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#webappuser">WebAppUser</a> for all bots, allowing Mini Apps to access a user&#39;s profile photo if their privacy settings allow for it.</li>
<li>Third parties (e.g., Mini App builders) that receive or process data on behalf of Mini Apps are now able to <a href="/bots/webapps#validating-data-for-third-party-use">validate it</a> without knowing the App&#39;s <a href="/bots/tutorial#obtain-your-bot-token">bot token</a>.</li>
<li>Debugging <a href="/bots/webapps#debug-mode-for-mini-apps">options</a> have been expanded to include full support for <strong>iOS devices</strong>. You can use these tools to find app-specific issues in your Mini App.</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><img class="emoji" src="//telegram.org/img/emoji/40/E29AA0.png" width="20" height="20" alt="⚠️" /> WARNING! <img class="emoji" src="//telegram.org/img/emoji/40/E29AA0.png" width="20" height="20" alt="⚠️" /></strong><br>Starting December 1, 2024 messages with video that are sent, copied or forwarded to groups and channels with a sufficiently large audience can be automatically scheduled by the server until the respective video is reencoded. Such messages will have 0 as their message identifier and can&#39;t be used before they are actually sent.</p>
</blockquote>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="october-31-2024" href="#october-31-2024"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>October 31, 2024</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 7.11</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#copytextbutton">CopyTextButton</a> and the field <em>copy_text</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#inlinekeyboardbutton">InlineKeyboardButton</a> allowing bots to send and receive inline buttons that copy arbitrary text.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>allow_paid_broadcast</em> to the methods <a href="/bots/api#sendmessage">sendMessage</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendphoto">sendPhoto</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideo">sendVideo</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendanimation">sendAnimation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendaudio">sendAudio</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddocument">sendDocument</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendpaidmedia">sendPaidMedia</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendsticker">sendSticker</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvideonote">sendVideoNote</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvoice">sendVoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendlocation">sendLocation</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendvenue">sendVenue</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendcontact">sendContact</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendpoll">sendPoll</a>, <a href="/bots/api#senddice">sendDice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendinvoice">sendInvoice</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendgame">sendGame</a>, <a href="/bots/api#sendmediagroup">sendMediaGroup</a> and <a href="/bots/api#copymessage">copyMessage</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartnertelegramapi">TransactionPartnerTelegramApi</a> for transactions related to paid broadcasted messages.</li>
<li>Introduced the ability to add media to existing text messages using the method <a href="/bots/api#editmessagemedia">editMessageMedia</a>.</li>
<li>Added support for hashtag and cashtag <a href="/bots/api#messageentity">entities</a> with a specified chat username that opens a search for the relevant tag within the specified chat.</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><img class="emoji" src="//telegram.org/img/emoji/40/E29AA0.png" width="20" height="20" alt="⚠️" /> WARNING! <img class="emoji" src="//telegram.org/img/emoji/40/E29AA0.png" width="20" height="20" alt="⚠️" /></strong><br>Starting December 1, 2024 messages with video that are sent, copied or forwarded to groups and channels with a sufficiently large audience can be automatically scheduled by the server until the respective video is reencoded. Such messages will have 0 as their message identifier and can&#39;t be used before they are actually sent.</p>
</blockquote>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="september-6-2024" href="#september-6-2024"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>September 6, 2024</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 7.10</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added updates about purchased paid media, represented by the class <a href="/bots/api#paidmediapurchased">PaidMediaPurchased</a> and the field <em>purchased_paid_media</em> in the class <a href="/bots/api#update">Update</a>.</li>
<li>Added the ability to specify a payload in <a href="/bots/api#sendpaidmedia">sendPaidMedia</a> that is received back by the bot in <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartneruser">TransactionPartnerUser</a> and <em>purchased_paid_media</em> updates.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>prize_star_count</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#giveawaycreated">GiveawayCreated</a>, <a href="/bots/api#giveaway">Giveaway</a>, <a href="/bots/api#giveawaywinners">GiveawayWinners</a> and <a href="/bots/api#chatboostsourcegiveaway">ChatBoostSourceGiveaway</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>is_star_giveaway</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#giveawaycompleted">GiveawayCompleted</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>SecondaryButton</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>.</li>
<li>Added the event <em>secondaryButtonClicked</em> for Mini Apps.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>bottomBarColor</em> and the method <em>setBottomBarColor</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>bottom_bar_bg_color</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#themeparams">ThemeParams</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="august-14-2024" href="#august-14-2024"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>August 14, 2024</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 7.9</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added support for <a href="https://telegram.org/blog/superchannels-star-reactions-subscriptions#super-channels">Super Channels</a>, allowing received channel messages to have users or other channels as their senders.</li>
<li>Added the ability to send paid media to any chat.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>business_connection_id</em> to the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpaidmedia">sendPaidMedia</a>, allowing bots to send paid media on behalf of a business account.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>paid_media</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartneruser">TransactionPartnerUser</a> for transactions involving paid media.</li>
<li>Added the fields <em>subscription_period</em> and <em>subscription_price</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatinvitelink">ChatInviteLink</a>.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#createchatsubscriptioninvitelink">createChatSubscriptionInviteLink</a>, allowing bots to create subscription invite links.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#editchatsubscriptioninvitelink">editChatSubscriptionInviteLink</a>, allowing bots to edit the <em>name</em> of subscription invite links.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>until_date</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatmembermember">ChatMemberMember</a> for members with an active subscription.</li>
<li>Added support for paid reactions and the class <a href="/bots/api#reactiontypepaid">ReactionTypePaid</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="july-31-2024" href="#july-31-2024"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>July 31, 2024</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 7.8</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the option for bots to set a <a href="/bots/webapps#launching-the-main-mini-app">Main Mini App</a>, which can be previewed and launched directly from a button in the bot&#39;s profile or a link.</li>
<li>Added the method <em>shareToStory</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>has_main_web_app</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#user">User</a>, which is returned in the response to <a href="/bots/api#getme">getMe</a>.</li>
<li>Added the parameter <em>business_connection_id</em> to the methods <a href="/bots/api#pinchatmessage">pinChatMessage</a> and <a href="/bots/api#unpinchatmessage">unpinChatMessage</a>, allowing bots to manage pinned messages on behalf of a business account.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="july-7-2024" href="#july-7-2024"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>July 7, 2024</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 7.7</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#refundedpayment">RefundedPayment</a>, containing information about a refunded payment.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>refunded_payment</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a>, describing a service message about a refunded payment.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>isVerticalSwipesEnabled</em> and the methods <em>enableVerticalSwipes</em>, <em>disableVerticalSwipes</em> to the class <a href="/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps">WebApp</a>.</li>
<li>Added the <a href="/bots/webapps#events-available-for-mini-apps">event</a> <em>scanQrPopupClosed</em> for Mini Apps.</li>
</ul>
<h4><a class="anchor" name="july-1-2024" href="#july-1-2024"><i class="anchor-icon"></i></a>July 1, 2024</h4>
<p><strong>Bot API 7.6</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Added the classes <a href="/bots/api#paidmedia">PaidMedia</a>, <a href="/bots/api#paidmediainfo">PaidMediaInfo</a>, <a href="/bots/api#paidmediapreview">PaidMediaPreview</a>, <a href="/bots/api#paidmediaphoto">PaidMediaPhoto</a> and <a href="/bots/api#paidmediavideo">PaidMediaVideo</a>, containing information about paid media.</li>
<li>Added the method <a href="/bots/api#sendpaidmedia">sendPaidMedia</a> and the classes <a href="/bots/api#inputpaidmedia">InputPaidMedia</a>, <a href="/bots/api#inputpaidmediaphoto">InputPaidMediaPhoto</a> and <a href="/bots/api#inputpaidmediavideo">InputPaidMediaVideo</a>, to support sending paid media.</li>
<li>Documented that the methods <a href="/bots/api#copymessage">copyMessage</a> and <a href="/bots/api#copymessages">copyMessages</a> cannot be used to copy paid media.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>can_send_paid_media</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#chatfullinfo">ChatFullInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>paid_media</em> to the classes <a href="/bots/api#message">Message</a> and <a href="/bots/api#externalreplyinfo">ExternalReplyInfo</a>.</li>
<li>Added the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartnertelegramads">TransactionPartnerTelegramAds</a>, containing information about Telegram Star transactions involving the Telegram Ads Platform.</li>
<li>Added the field <em>invoice_payload</em> to the class <a href="/bots/api#transactionpartneruser">TransactionPartnerUser</a>, containing the bot-specified invoice payload.</li>
